name: Sogabe Orie
source:
Polite and approachable, the Mikado household's sole maid is also responsible for the household meals. Her cooking repertoire is quite diverse with dishes including frog's legs and tortoise shell stew in addition to more conventional meals. She frequently uses the kitchen late at night to experiment with new dishes until they are of an acceptable standard to serve the Mikado masters.

[Spoiler] Orie's parents were servants at the Mikado household and together with her younger brother she assisted with the household chores until she was old enough to assume more important responsibilities on her own. She has never been to school but is very skilled at her tasks because of the spartan training endured under Heizo. 

Yuri frequently abuses Orie through physical beatings and coercion to sexual acts with other household staff. Orie hates Yuri and the other abusive Mikado members enough to kill them, but her conditioning was complete enough to compel her to suffer in silence.

Orie will go to great lengths to help Ririka escape the mansion after the rite. Ririka saved Orie from a certain death at Heizo's hands which led to Orie being charged with caring for Ririka's daily needs. They became friends despite their master-servant relationship and share hobbies such as reading girls' magazines. After learning about most of the secrets of the Mikado household and the visit of Yoshito's professor prior to the start of the rite, she feels she has to entrust Yoshito with Ririka's fate as he is the only person she trusts amongst the participants.

Despite appearances, Orie is actually older than Yoshito and can easily pass for a high-school student should she choose to do so. [/Spoiler]
